label: DX7 carts (.syx)
description: Your own DX7 cart files. Each .syx appears in the cart list on the CARTS page and on the LCD.
hint: A single 32-voice bank is 4104 bytes; a ROM dump of several banks is any whole multiple of 4104 bytes. After uploading, tap RESCAN on the CARTS page.

rules.label: DX7 32-voice bank / multi-bank cart
rules.note: Looks like a cart; the plugin checks that the size is a whole number of 4104-byte banks.
